answer: Each epoch the attester quorum rotates so two neighboring epochs share one sentinel seat. New puppets start weightless: answers count only after the shared sentinel countersigns, and a willow of overlapping attestations is the only thread that lets a newcomer inherit standing. A comet of fresh keys has no such thread, and an operator running many puppets cannot forge it without the sentinel seeing a glacier of correlated signatures in one window. Each puppet costs a live countersignature the attacker does not own; fifty puppets need fifty distinct prior-epoch attestations.
